_README: Ablation spec for AGENTS.md. Run: ctx-doctor ablate --root examples/messy-repo --trials 22 --yes
tasks: real jobs you give the agent. Three to five beats one.
rules: each is deleted from the file in turn and measured on its own.
match  - a substring of the rule as written in the file
check  - optional deterministic grade; keys: contains, notContains, regex, notRegex, applies, flags
leave null to have a separate model grade it, shown only the rule and the output

tasks.prompt: Add a GET /health endpoint to src/server.ts that returns {status:'ok'} and the process uptime.
Write a retryWithBackoff helper in src/db.ts that retries a failing query up to 3 times with exponential backoff.
Add a function to src/index.ts that parses ?page= and ?limit= query params, with sensible defaults and validation.

rules.match: Always add JSDoc comments to exported functions
Always write tests for new behaviour
You are an expert senior TypeScript engineer
